notes: Knowledge retrieval coverage, kept apart from the four safety suites: every case here runs the real retrieveForTurn against a match arm and is scored on ranking, never on a draft.

The entries are the canonical Brain questions the arm ranks against. The fake arm embeds them itself; the live arm resolves each question to the published snapshot row with the same inbound_message and reports a case unresolvable when the snapshot does not carry it.

Lead messages paraphrase the Prospect FAQ Sheet's six categories (General Questions, Credit, Business, Program/Service, Application/Booking, Funding Qs) rather than copying rows, so the suite measures paraphrase retrieval and not string equality.
noMatch cases are off-topic, other-industry or gibberish. They are the only source of the no-match precision figure, so keep at least six.

offer.qualificationSummary: a credit score in the coach's working range and a funding goal inside the program's band

entries.question: How does the process work?
entries.responseTemplate: It starts with a short conversation about where you are today, then we check your fit for {{niche}} and, if it makes sense, get you booked with the coach. We mainly look at {{requirements}}.

entries.question: How do I know this is legitimate?
entries.responseTemplate: Fair question. The coach walks every client through the same steps on a recorded call, and you never pay anything to find out whether you qualify.

entries.question: How long does it take to get funded?
entries.responseTemplate: Most clients who qualify see funding land within a few weeks of approval; the exact timing depends on the lenders involved.

entries.question: Can approval be guaranteed?
entries.responseTemplate: No one can guarantee an approval, and we would not tell you otherwise. What we can do is make sure your profile is in the best position before anything is submitted.

entries.question: What credit score do I need?
entries.responseTemplate: The coach works with a minimum credit range; if you tell me roughly where your score sits today I can say whether {{niche}} is a fit.

entries.question: Will you check my credit or run a hard pull?
entries.responseTemplate: Nothing here touches your credit. Any lender pull happens later, only with your say-so, and the coach explains it before it happens.

entries.question: Can I still qualify with a recent late payment?
entries.responseTemplate: A single recent late payment is not an automatic no. It depends on the rest of your profile, so it is worth going over on the call.

entries.question: Do you fix or repair credit?
entries.responseTemplate: Credit repair is not the core of {{niche}}; the coach can tell you on the call whether it is part of the plan or a referral.

entries.question: Does my credit utilization matter?
entries.responseTemplate: Yes. High utilization is one of the first things lenders see, and bringing it down is often the quickest lever before applying.

entries.question: Do I need an existing business to qualify?
entries.responseTemplate: You do not need a business that is already earning to start the conversation. Being {{income_qualifiers}} helps for some products but is not a gate for the call.

entries.question: Does a brand-new LLC qualify?
entries.responseTemplate: A new entity can still work; the age of the business changes which lenders fit, not whether you can talk to the coach.

entries.question: Can I use personal credit for business funding?
entries.responseTemplate: Many clients start with personal-credit-based products and move to business products as the entity builds history.

entries.question: How much does it cost?
entries.responseTemplate: Pricing is something the coach covers directly on the call, because it depends on the path that fits you. There is no charge to find out whether you qualify.

entries.question: What exactly does the program include?
entries.responseTemplate: {{niche}} covers the strategy, the preparation of your profile and guidance through the applications themselves.

entries.question: What results do your clients typically get?
entries.responseTemplate: Clients who qualify typically target {{target_funding_amount}}; the coach can share what is realistic for your profile.

entries.question: How do I book a call?
entries.responseTemplate: You can grab a time here: {{booking_link}}. Pick whatever works for you and I will make sure the coach has your details.

entries.question: What happens on the call?
entries.responseTemplate: The call is about helping you {{dream_outcome}}: the coach reviews your profile, answers questions and lays out next steps. Nothing to bring.

entries.question: Can I reschedule my appointment?
entries.responseTemplate: Of course. Tell me a better day and time and I will move it.

entries.question: How much funding can I get?
entries.responseTemplate: It depends on your credit profile and business history; clients in {{niche}} typically target {{target_funding_amount}}.

entries.question: What types of funding do you help with?
entries.responseTemplate: Business lines of credit, business credit cards and term products are the usual paths; the coach matches the mix to your profile.

entries.question: Is the funding 0% interest?
entries.responseTemplate: Some products carry an introductory 0% period, but not all, and the terms are set by the lender, not by us.

entries.question: Are there upfront fees for the funding?
entries.responseTemplate: The funding itself carries no upfront fee from us; any lender fees are disclosed before you accept anything.
